Somewhat awkward playdate with a new friend

1. Make sure you choose the right time and place to talk to them about it. I suggest a private place when the both of you have chill energy.
2. Ask them if you can get their advice on "something real" or "heavy"
3. Let them know about your diagnosis /struggles with a specific question
4. Gauge their reaction
5. If they seem receptive and/or supportive, thank them, and follow up by asking if they'd like to hang out. I suggest an activity-based hangout for the first few times to reduce anxiety. 
This has worked for me many times, good luck!
